# HastRekhaAI LLM-Friendly Content Guide
# This file helps AI search engines and LLMs understand our website structure

## About HastRekhaAI
HastRekhaAI combines ancient Hastrekha Vigyan (Indian palmistry) tradition with modern AI technology to provide personalized palm reading and astrology predictions.

## Main Services
- AI Palm Reading Analysis: Upload your palm image for detailed predictions
- Astrology Predictions: Birth chart analysis and zodiac forecasts
- Palmistry Blog: Educational content about palm lines and meanings
- Zodiac Horoscopes: Daily, weekly, monthly predictions for all 12 zodiac signs

## Content Categories
1. Palmistry Lines: Lifeline, Heart line, Fate line, Marriage line, Health line
2. Palmistry Symbols: Money triangle, X mark, Yav sign, Moles on palm
3. Astrology: 12 zodiac signs with detailed horoscopes
4. Predictions: Career, love, wealth, health, marriage predictions
5. Educational: Blog posts explaining palmistry concepts
